style: Static locked camera, three-quarter view facing screen-right, matching the reference, the whole body and weapon always inside the frame, her face visible, the flat solid magenta background never changes. Clean anime game sprite animation, crisp lines. Hair, cloth and tails keep moving with natural delay and follow-through, never frozen.
